name: whyve
description: Keep project decisions, their reasons, and other project context across AI agent sessions, stored as Markdown files in your project.

interface.shortDescription: Remember project decisions and the reasons behind them
interface.longDescription: Keep project decisions and their reasons across AI agent sessions. Whyve stores decisions, observations, assumptions, intents, terms, and documents as Markdown files in your project's context folder. Set up each project with $whyve:init: choose which record types to use and whether recording is explicit, automatic, or adaptive. Ask for a past rationale, or compare a proposed change with the current decision. Requires Node.js 20.20.0 or newer. No Whyve account or remote service is required. Anything the agent reads is processed by your AI host.
capabilities: Compare proposed changes with current decisions
defaultPrompt: Set up Whyve for this project and explain the recording choices.
Why did we make the current decision about this feature?
Compare this proposal with the current decision and its reason before changing anything.
